description: Use this when the user wants to confirm that the text blocks of their Markdown (headings, paragraphs, list items, table cells, code) are present in a PDF in the same order. With an uploaded PDF it checks that file; without one it builds the PDF from the text as make_pdf does and checks it. Reports blocks found in order, missing and out of order. Compares text only: it does not check fonts, layout, images or spelling, and does not edit the PDF.

file.description: Optional: a PDF to check, e.g. the report.pdf downloaded from make_pdf or exported from another app. Without it, the tool builds the PDF from the text and checks that.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

font_size.description: Body text size in points from 10 to 14, e.g. 11 (default).

format.description: markdown (default) reads # headings, lists, tables and so on; plain prints the text as paragraphs with no markup.

margins.description: Page margins: normal (1 in / 25.4 mm, default) or narrow (0.5 in / 12.7 mm).

page_numbers.description: true (default) prints "page / total" at the bottom of each page except a title page.

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US, default) or a4.

table_of_contents.description: true to add a contents page listing headings of levels 1-3 with their page numbers. Default false.

text.description:
The Markdown whose blocks should be found in the PDF, e.g. "# Budget

| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Rent | 1200 |".

title.description: Optional document title printed at the top (or on a title page), e.g. "Q3 Field Report". Up to 200 characters.

title_page.description: true to print the title on its own first page. Needs a title (or uses the first heading). Default false.

name: check_pdf_text
title: Check PDF text against Markdown
